android.desc:
Smart Clock & Timer is a clean and modern Android app built for users who want a simple clock interface, precise alarms, and fully customizable timers in one place.

With Smart Clock & Timer, you can create custom timers with a name, category, duration, image, and sound. You can also set alarms with hour, minute, and second precision, making the app useful for daily routines, workouts, cooking, study sessions, reminders, and personal schedules.

Key features:
• Create custom timers with photo and sound support
• Set exact alarms with hour, minute, and second selection
• Add custom labels, images, and sounds for each alarm or timer
• Control notification repeat count and repeat interval
• Set ring volume for each timer or alarm if it is ignored
• View active timers with real remaining time
• Personalize the app with a modern theme color
• Manage everything in a simple three-tab layout: Timers, Clock, and Settings

The app is designed for fast everyday use with a modern interface and local on-device storage. Your timers, alarms, selected media, and settings stay on your device.

Smart Clock & Timer is a practical productivity tool for users who want both style and flexibility in a clock and timer app.
